items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Lesley Hems directly; the interviewer mentions 'The Lesley Hems records' and the interviewee responds by asking about a different musician (Horace Dias) potentially being on those records, showing no personal connection to Lesley Hems.

ctx.x: I can't remember too well if I worked any jobs with Johnny in those days. I knew of Johnny and had met him and certainly talked with him many times. I can't recall playing any early jobs with Johnny until our association in 1946 at WSMB radio station.
The Lesley Hems records, they sound like nickels, you know. He made two tunes, I forget the date, but the late 20s, Johnny Harmon's Bayou's
was that when he used this piano player, Horace Dias? Was Horace Dias on some of those records with him?
